maint.every: Often 60,000–100,000+ miles thanks to regenerative braking
maint.note: Owners report $500 at an independent shop and $2,000–$2,300 at Tesla for pads and rotors.

maint.every: Often 60,000–100,000+ miles; have rear calipers cleaned yearly in salted-road areas
maint.note: Few owners report rear brake jobs; costs are similar to the front. The rear calipers include the electric parking brake.
This is the small 12-volt battery, not the high-voltage drive battery. Owners report $250–$300.

maint.job: Battery coolant system check and repair
maint.every: No set interval; check the level and look for leaks at service visits
maint.note: Owners report $52 for a coolant valve and about $820–$960 (Canadian) for a coolant pump.
